visual_description.scene: Narrow pedestrian street paved with reddish interlocking brick. On the left is a low pale-pink perimeter wall with a tall dark metal gate, a red medical-cross sign and a small posted sign; palm foliage and dense overhead utility cables cross the view. A white multi-storey building rises behind the trees. On the right is a long weathered light-grey masonry facade with repeated openings and a narrow raised concrete sidewalk.
visual_description.visible_facade: pale-pink plaster perimeter wall, dark metal gate and red medical-cross sign; adjoining weathered light-grey masonry facade
visual_description.openings: large metal gate; repeated rectangular openings on the right-side facade, details partly obscured
visual_description.street_furniture: palm trees, overhead utility cables, narrow concrete sidewalks
visual_description.signage: red medical-cross sign and a small wall-mounted poster
visual_description.cautions: Do not infer unseen windows, doors, balconies, exact material composition or building use beyond visible evidence.

visual_description.scene: Straight urban street with grey asphalt/concrete carriageway and a curb painted alternating yellow and white. The left side has a pale masonry wall and an ornate light-coloured facade with a tall arched entrance, decorative mouldings and turquoise/green trim around the ground-floor openings. The right side is a long yellow-and-cream multi-storey facade with repeated arched ground-floor bays, columns and dark awnings/signboards.
visual_description.visible_facade: left: pale facade with decorative arched portal and turquoise/green trim; right: yellow-and-cream facade with repeated arcaded bays and columns
visual_description.openings: large arched entrance and smaller ground-floor openings on the left; repeated arched openings on the right
visual_description.street_furniture: yellow-and-white curb, utility poles and overhead wires, dark shop awnings
visual_description.signage: dark shop signboards/awnings are visible but lettering is not reliably legible
visual_description.cautions: Do not invent upper-floor window counts, balcony details, building names or exact facade materials.

visual_description.scene: Street bordered on the left by a long dark, rough stone masonry wall and an older pale stone building rising behind it, with a high curved/parapet-like roofline. In the middle distance is a low light-coloured building with repeated arched openings and a reddish tiled roof. On the right foreground is a tall modern light-grey building with large plain wall panels. A red car is parked near the right side.
visual_description.visible_facade: left: dark rough-cut stone boundary wall and pale historic masonry above; centre: light facade with repeated arches and red tiled roof; right: modern light-grey panelled facade
visual_description.openings: repeated arches on the central building; individual openings on the right are not clearly visible
visual_description.street_furniture: overhead utility wires and parked red car
visual_description.signage: no confidently legible sign is visible
